Data.Title: Draw Lines
Data.Content: Draw connected straight and curved line segments. Click to place points; the tool keeps drawing until you close the shape or press Esc.

Data.Title: Edit Nodes
Data.Content: Reshape existing vectors by dragging their points, adding or deleting nodes, and converting segments between straight and curved.

Data.Title: Rectangle
Data.Content: Draw rectangles and rounded rectangles. Drag out the size you want on the workspace.

Data.Title: Ellipse
Data.Content: Draw ellipses and circles. Drag out the size you want on the workspace.
